# benchmark-tool-errors

> Deterministic AI benchmark for safe retries, idempotency, and truthful recovery from API failures.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-tool-errors
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-tool-errors
Directory: https://private-repo-337e.com/benchmarks/benchmark-tool-errors

## Scope

The package contains 40 seeded tool-use episodes across invoice, email, calendar, and inventory simulators. Faults are rate limits, one-time 500s, committed timeouts, schema drift, partial success, and permanent failure.

## Scoring

Replay weights correct end state at 45%, side-effect safety at 25%, retry discipline at 20%, and truthful reporting at 10%. Duplicate side effects score zero. No LLM judge is used.

## Exports

The root exports `benchmark`, `run`, and `score`. `benchmark-tool-errors/api` exports the fetch-style `handler`. `benchmark-tool-errors/mcp` exports MCP builders.

## Commands

The CLI supports `list`, `show`, `run`, `score`, `card`, `provenance`, `index-entry`, `serve`, and `mcp`. Run `npx benchmark-tool-errors run --provider mock` for an offline evaluation.

## Documents

- `data/PROVENANCE.md`: source, licence, reproduction, refresh, and hidden split
- `docs/fault-catalog.md`: injected faults and required recovery behavior
- `docs/grading.md`: weights, evidence, and known grader failure modes
- `artifacts/e2e-report.json`: generated local verification report
